package.description: FreSH as a single executable, with no installer and no registry.

en-US.description: FreSH as a single executable, with no installer and no registry.
en-US.longDescription:
The same shell as S42yt.FreSH, delivered as one executable. Nothing is written
to the registry, no Explorer entries are added and no administrator rights are
needed. Settings still live in ~/.freshrc.
en-US.name: FreSH Portable
